query: We need to track invoices in numu now — customer, amount, due date, status (draft/sent/paid/void), and they hang off a project. Walk me through adding this. I don't want to write a new table if I can avoid it.
Add a `priority` enum field (low/normal/high/urgent) to the case type, defaulting to normal. Where does that live?

I want a `ticket` object that customers can open. it should belong to a project the way notes do so whoever can see the project can see its tickets. how do i set that up so i don't have to write any rust?

Marketing wants to capture leads — name, email, source, owner. Every time we add one of these we end up writing a model struct, a migration and a CRUD handler. There has to be a cheaper way in numu, right?
On the comment type I want subject_id to point at ANY object, not just a project — a comment on a case, a comment on a note, whatever. How do I express a parent that isn't typed to one prefix?
case.workflow_id is `readonly required` but creates keep blowing up with a 422 saying workflow_id is required. The user obviously can't set it. what's going on?
I added a `product` type to a new seed migration, ran migrate, but OPTIONS /api/objects/product still 404s and POST fails too. The SQL definitely ran. Why isn't the new type showing up?
Want the case's `external_ref` field to be given at creation time and then frozen — nobody should be able to PATCH it afterward. How do I mark a field set-once?
Should `case.status` live as a real column in the cases projection table, or just in entity_data.data like everything else? Trying to decide if this new `region` field on case needs to be typed too.
Adding a `perm_class: owner_grade` field to the invoice type so only owners can write the amount after creation. Does that go in the field definition or somewhere in rbac.rs?
Why did GET /api/objects/case/CAS_abc123 return 404 for this user when the row clearly exists? I thought they were a member. Trying to understand the reach logic.
I'm adding a new endpoint and I want to share a case with another member and give them editor rank. Where do I call grant_owner / require_action and how does the reach cascade pick it up?
My handler does `sqlx::query(...).fetch_one(&db).await.unwrap()` and a missing row gives a bare 500 with no request-id. How should I be mapping the sqlx error to a proper problem+json response?
PATCH on a case isn't honoring If-Match — I can clobber a stale version. How do I wire the ETag/optimistic-concurrency check correctly in this handler?
We keep forgetting that every `required readonly` field needs a default. Can we make that a CI check so a bad seed fails the build instead of failing at runtime?

I want a DB trigger plus a handler check that both refuse to let scope_parent_id be changed after create, so even a direct SQL UPDATE can't break set-once. How do I do the Rust-gate + DB-backstop doubling?
The omnisearch index over `searchable` fields — how is it actually built and refreshed? I want to add the projects/notes to it.
Add a migration to create the `sessions` table — we need server-side session storage with an expiry and a last-seen column. What columns should it have?
How does the cases_guard trigger validate workflow transitions on the cases projection? Want to add a new status transition rule to the workflow engine.
Refactor objects.rs build_create_data so it reads cleaner — the defaults loop and the required-check are tangled. Pure code-quality pass, no behavior change.
